let fieldMaybe: string | undefined = "field";
class FieldFlow {
  count = fieldMaybe === undefined ? 0 : fieldMaybe.length;
  static count = fieldMaybe === undefined ? 0 : fieldMaybe.length;
  assigned = (fieldMaybe = "assigned").length;
}
console.log(new FieldFlow().count, FieldFlow.count);
const computedMethodKey = "method";
const equalMethodKey = "method";
const computedStaticKey = "staticMethod";
class ComputedOverloads {
  [computedMethodKey](value: number): number;
  [equalMethodKey](value: number) { return value + 1; }
  static [computedStaticKey](value: number): number;
  static [computedStaticKey](value: number) { return value + 2; }
}
console.log(new ComputedOverloads().method(1), ComputedOverloads.staticMethod(1));
const computedFieldKey = "value";
class ComputedInitializedField { [computedFieldKey]: number; constructor() { this.value = 8; } }
console.log(new ComputedInitializedField().value);
